meta.name: inspect-profile
meta.description: Explain in plain English what a nyann profile enables — stack, branching, hooks, extras, conventions, documentation. TRIGGER when the user says "what does the nextjs-prototype profile do", "explain the python-cli profile", "show me what <name> enables", "what's in profile X", "describe the <name> profile", "inspect profile X", "/nyann:inspect-profile". Do NOT trigger on "show this repo's setup" — that's the `explain-state` skill (reads the repo, not a profile file). Do NOT trigger on "apply profile X to this repo" — that's `bootstrap-project`. Do NOT trigger on "save this setup as a profile" — that's `learn-profile`.
